cc:Work.dc:description: Source: data/current_extensions.json; SHA-256 dd3c3e39f41f4aa68b814d809246d5057dfa0f645aff082fe65e8b5ccd2ad58a. Independent recount from current_inputs.jsonl, with core accuracy/coverage cross-checks. Bars are within-bin outcome percentages; labels show question counts. Empty bins omitted. Descriptive association, not a causal or monotonic claim.
